title: About SPACE — Direct Buyer of Independent Music Catalogs
description: Learn how SPACE values and acquires independent music catalogs across ambient, lo-fi, electronic, and wellness genres with direct offers and fast closing.
headings: We buy music catalogs that others overlook.
Find out what your catalog is worth.
paragraphs: SPACE focuses exclusively on ambient, lo-fi, meditation, and wellness music — the genres that Hipgnosis, Reservoir, and Primary Wave won't touch because they're too small. We think that's a mistake.

The ambient and wellness music market is growing at 23.7% annually. Meditation apps, sleep products, corporate wellness programs, and streaming platforms are all competing for the same limited pool of high-quality catalog. Independent creators who built these catalogs years ago often don't realize what they're sitting on.

We make an immediate, data-driven cash offer based on a catalog's streaming performance, revenue history, and rights clarity. Creators can sell 50%, 75%, or 100% of their catalog — retaining creative control over future work in every case.
No auctions. No commissions. No investors. A direct offer within 5–7 business days, and payment on closing.
Free evaluation. No obligation. 5–7 day response.
We review revenue-generating music catalogs directly, across genres.
Bi-weekly market insights and creator tips.
